description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2620012917920 INNER TUBE,PNEUMATI: Line 0001 Qty 404 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0053 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 60. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 091X8 AS50141-15X600-6/TR67/OFF CENTE; 091X8 GL-6067N; 0A1K8 092-501-0; 6K4C8 2012B900-30. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
